requiredFindings.title: An empty X4T dependency point has one R2
requiredFindings.failureScenario: F00's r8 split says create.after and write.before of x4t.floor-publication.dependency each admit either Committed or INSTALLATION.INCOMPLETE, because whether the next fenced read names that file is X4T r9's reading and X9 does not restate it. The F00 cell and L11 spell the same disjunction. X4T r9 item 2 reads only the retained state.v1's closure, with no directory scan. Item 7 writes dependencies before the pointer, and a record written before that replacement is unreferenced and harmless (X4B item 6). At a2c5e8b, publish_protocol runs every dependency scope and then the pointer scope. write_dependency creates a leaf only when absent; an existing leaf whose bytes differ refuses TrustRow::Incomplete. A kill at either point leaves the pointer unchanged, so the next fenced read does not name the new leaf. The next publication writes a determined content-addressed list. Whether this leaf is on that list, and whether its on-disk bytes equal the bytes being written, is fixed by the census occurrence. Item 5 makes each x4t.floor-publication occurrence a function of the script and the product, equal across two census runs, before any kill. The occurrence index is part of the point identity. The development split (Incomplete at create.after#1, write.before#1 and write.before#3; Committed at create.after#4, create.after#7 and write.before#6) shows the points differ. A class-level disjunction accepts a lawful refusal and a lawful commit for one point. create.after leaves the file empty. write.before does not: primitive_write writes the first half and then holds. Both differ from a non-empty object. INSTALLATION.INCOMPLETE is not a detail. X4T r9 item 10's incomplete row is CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED, subject installation-incomplete, which TrustRow::Incomplete returns at a2c5e8b. Required: one R2 per census occurrence of those two point names. Collision with unequal bytes is CONFIG.CUSTODY_REFUSED, subject installation-incomplete. A leaf the next publication does not write, or whose bytes already equal, is Committed. L11 uses the same row for this state. The rest of F00's r8 split stays.

scope: Law X9 r8, an amendment. RF-1: F00's empty X4T dependency points are two-valued; each census occurrence has one R2 under X4T r9's read set. No other accepted outcome changes. No product cargo.
